# Halal Goes

> Halal Goes is a Canadian halal food-delivery marketplace, launching in Ontario.
> Every restaurant is admin-verified against a seven-point halal certification review
> before it is listed. The platform is pre-launch; both sign-up forms are waitlists.

## What Halal Goes is
- A food-delivery marketplace for **verified halal** restaurants.
- The single differentiator is **verification**: an admin checks each restaurant's
  halal certificate against a seven-point review and records who issued it, the
  certificate number, and the date checked. The badge on a listing is that record.
- Halal Goes does **not** itself certify food and makes **no** religious ruling.
  An expired certificate means the platform's knowledge has lapsed — the restaurant
  is hidden from customers until renewal — not that the food is not halal.

## Coverage and status
- Launching in **Ontario, Canada** (Greater Toronto Area first). CAD.
- **Pre-launch.** There is no app to download yet; the site collects a waitlist.

## For people ordering
- Menu price + a delivery fee shown before payment + tax + a tip that goes entirely
  to the rider. Orders are sealed at the restaurant and tracked to the door.
- Join the waitlist with a phone number (an explicit, timestamped consent to be
  texted once at launch — CASL).

## For restaurants
- **0% commission at launch.** Payment processing fees are itemised per payout.
- Onboarding is a certificate, a menu, and hours — no hardware, no exclusivity.
- Join with an email for early access.

## Contact
- Website: https://halalgoes.com
